stories.story_title: OpenAI Introduces GDPval to Benchmark Models on 44 Real-World Occupations
stories.why_this_story: OpenAI is shifting AI evaluation from abstract academic tests to measuring capability on actual economically valuable job tasks across 44 professions.
stories.viral_angle: AI benchmarks are no longer testing trivia or synthetic coding—they are now measuring real-world economic output across entire job markets.
stories.story_sentence: Everyone thinks AI models are evaluated on coding puzzles, but OpenAI just launched a benchmark testing AI across 44 real-world occupations.

stories.caption:
OpenAI just introduced GDPval—a new benchmark designed to measure model performance on real-world economically valuable tasks across 44 occupations.

Traditional benchmarks like MMLU or HumanEval test academic trivia or isolated code snippets. GDPval shifts the focus directly onto real workforce output.
